notes.title: A lot of languages!
notes.content:
Since release we've added support of numerous different languages. This became possible mostly by SteamGifts community. Big thanks to them! However there are still many languages left and you can help with it. Visit this link. Currently there are following languages:

Arabic
Belarusian
Brazilian Portuguese
Czech
English
Estonian
French
German
Greek
Italian
Japanese
Korean
Polish
Portuguese
Russian
Simplified Chinese
Spanish
Thai
Traditional Chinese
Turkish
Ukrainian


Also, if you still don't have the game, you can try to win it here.

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.content:
Fixed bug with completed compounds counter which would make you think that game is shorter than it is. Bug affected only purple compounds related achievements and appropriate Steam stats (you got achievements earlier than you should).
2 times more music.
Added various languages.
